title: Pan2025: Cross-session motor imagery dataset from Pan et al. 2025
description: Cross-session motor imagery EEG dataset from 10 healthy participants performing cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery across two sessions. EEG was recorded from 28 channels at 250 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2, and about 180 trials were collected per session. In the second session, test trials included online feedback. This BIDS re-release was generated with MOABB from the original Harvard Dataverse deposit.
methods_description: Cued left- vs right-hand motor imagery (4 s rest, 4 s task), about 180 trials per session over two sessions. EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 at 250 Hz from 28 channels in a 10-10 montage, with online bandpass 0.01-200 Hz and 50 Hz notch. In session 2, the first 30 trials were used for training and the remaining trials for testing with online feedback.
